verdict.rationale: No evidence describes dedicated retention or deletion controls. The pack shows only building blocks: Supabase Cron can schedule recurring in-database jobs (for example, purge jobs), self-hosting puts all data under your own infrastructure, and daily backups exist on paid plans. Retention and deletion must therefore be assembled by the user. Missing for 10: documented data-retention policies, backup and log retention settings, account/project data deletion guarantees, user-data erasure tooling, and independent corroboration.
